declared difference (issue #895, FAIL half): a poll fn whose catch path falls through to a lastOk* clock stamp that
follows the try/catch (a/b: the failure is swallowed, so the success-time watchdog never sees it) is a FAIL row. A
catch that rethrows or returns (c, d) and a stamp inside the try (e) are clean. f keeps its no-recovery WARN and adds the
FAIL.
-- args --
@DIR@
-- want --
exit 1
FAIL  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/a-block.js:11  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' swallows a failure: its catch path neither rethrows nor returns and falls through to a lastOk* clock stamp, so the success-time watchdog never sees the failure -- rethrow in the catch (or return), or stamp lastOk* only on the validated success path (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)
FAIL  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/b-promise.js:7  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' swallows a failure: its catch path neither rethrows nor returns and falls through to a lastOk* clock stamp, so the success-time watchdog never sees the failure -- rethrow in the catch (or return), or stamp lastOk* only on the validated success path (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)
WARN  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/f-no-recovery.js:9  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' has a catch path with no location.reload(/location.href recovery anywhere in the file -- kiosk/HMI will stay blank after a station restart; add a watchdog on time since the last success (lastOkAt) -> fetchT probe of the app marker -> location.reload()
FAIL  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/f-no-recovery.js:9  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' swallows a failure: its catch path neither rethrows nor returns and falls through to a lastOk* clock stamp, so the success-time watchdog never sees the failure -- rethrow in the catch (or return), or stamp lastOk* only on the validated success path (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)
-- stderr --
-- a-block.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- b-promise.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  await load().catch(e => paint("error"));
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- c-rethrow.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
    throw err;
  }
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- d-return.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
    return;
  }
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- e-success-path.js --
let lastOkAt = 0;
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
    lastOkAt = Date.now();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 3e4) location.reload();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
-- f-no-recovery.js --
async function poll() {
  try {
    await load();
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  }
  lastOkAt = Date.now();
}
setTimeout(poll, 5000);
